title: 2242. Maximum Score of a Node Sequence

examples.explanation: The figure above shows the graph and the chosen node sequence [0,1,2,3]. The score of the node sequence is 5 + 2 + 9 + 8 = 24. It can be shown that no other node sequence has a score of more than 24. Note that the sequences [3,1,2,0] and [1,0,2,3] are also valid and have a score of 24. The sequence [0,3,2,4] is not valid since no edge connects nodes 0 and 3.
The figure above shows the graph. There are no valid node sequences of length 4, so we return -1.
